title: workflow speed: the reqwest and esaxx-rs patches as a pinned git revision, not path crates
goal: The two [patch.crates-io] path crates under vendor/ keep rmcp, ra2a, tokenizers, fastembed and the candle crates out of the seed snapshot and out of the machine's compiler cache, because a path crate's rlib embeds the worktree's path. Host them on a no-PR branch of this repository and pin the patch table to its revision, so the whole chain is keyed by a stable source: in the snapshot, and a cache hit in every worktree.
